# CI workflows

All jobs call `just` recipes from the root `justfile` (15 §5.1); YAML never re-implements a recipe. CI-only glue that has no place in the public recipe catalog lives in `[private]` `ci-*` recipes (hidden from `just --list`, bodies in `scripts/ci/`). Toolchain comes from `mise.toml` via `.github/actions/setup`. Runners are Linux except the `macos-15` leg of `portability`.

The React Native build lanes (`ios-eas.yml`, `ios-gha-macos.yml`) were removed with the React Native app. `android.yml` is rewritten in place for the native Android app, and the native iOS lane (`ios.yml`) is added with the native iOS app; their rows land with those changes.

## Workflow shape

Every workflow follows the same layout so the Actions UI reads as a tree:

- **Header comment:** purpose, triggers, the `just` recipes it calls, required and optional secrets, and the job tree.
- **Jobs:** a human-readable `name:`, least-privilege `permissions:`, a job-level `concurrency` group (`${{ github.workflow }}-<job>-${{ github.ref }}`, plus the matrix key for matrix jobs) and `timeout-minutes`. Fan-in jobs list an explicit `needs:`; root jobs carry a `# needs: none (root of the job tree)` comment, because GitHub rejects an empty `needs: []`. Each workflow ends in a `Report · …` summary job that needs every other job.
- **Steps:** every step is named `Phase · action`, with phases in the order `Setup`, `Verify`, `Build`, `Test`, `Report` (for example `Setup · Check out`, `Verify · Lint`, `Test · Full test suite`, `Report · Job results`). Run steps call `just`; the only exceptions are job-summary/timing glue and `portability.yml`'s bootstrap step, which runs before `just` exists.

## Shared pieces

- `.github/actions/setup/action.yml` - composite: `jdx/mise-action` (cache on), pnpm store cache keyed on `pnpm-lock.yaml`, `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`, optional `uv sync --frozen` under `workers/**`.
- `.gitleaks.toml` (repo root) - extends the default ruleset, adds an `age` secret-key rule, allowlists `.env.example`, `planning/**`, `**/*.enc.yaml`.

Action pins (major tags, verified against each repo's latest release on 2026-09-09): `actions/checkout@v7`, `actions/cache@v6`, `actions/upload-artifact@v7`, `jdx/mise-action@v4`, `gitleaks/gitleaks-action@v3`. Renovate keeps them current (15 §9).
